Season’s Greetings - during the 2 weeks leading up to the end of each season, has the base innates of each of the current and approaching season if double racial innates are possessed, or x2 innates of each of the two seasons if triple racial innates are possessed

Draw on Strength – May use racial Affirms to grant temp life. Each Affirm grants +3/1 temp life for 5 minutes rather than their normal benefit. These do not stack with other supernatural temp life. Magic Biscuit – Lembas are no longer considered flesh and blood effects, they are just magic biscuits.

Fearsome Fey - By suddenly and dramatically revealing themselves or their true appearance to a Barony Human may cause a one-minute-Fear in them of unlimited levels in effect. This may be used against more than one target simultaneously. However any target who is Immune to Fear may instead choose to enter a 25% rage against the user. An individual can only be affected by this ability once from any given fey.
Elven innates of race - may not select Double Innates ability
Elven innates of race - may not select Double Innates ability

Immortal body – Loses 8 Affirms, but gains a permanent Affirm. A Dispel 2 removes this for 5 minutes. This may not be used with Armour of XXX or Draw on Strength.

displayName: Purchase further innates of own colour
desc: Purchase further innates of own colour (standard) - 12pts/mana-pt
Must eat at least eight lembas per day (or four per section on non- double-lengths), or loses all strength and two levels of life till next eats. Lembas now cure 3/3.

The Drowe’s Returner can now only be harmed by magical damage and may use any of the basic Drowe racial innates (1st – 8th Drowe abilities) which the Drowe had remaining unused at the time of death. The Returner’s damage is now also magical and can only be reduced by Magical Armour Class rather than other forms of AC.
From Layered Defence, may now stack 3 affirms at a time.
Gains an additional innate of the racial ability 'The Touch'. This may be purchased once per table post 8th.
This means that they do not need to adventure with an Athfanal master. They can still be dominated by an Athfanal in the normal means but by the next adventure is considered to be free again.
Grants + 1 MAC

As the priest ability but is physical in nature so does not function vs. etheric undead.

Any treasure gained from adventure is increased in value by 25%

By Magically reading the “Water” in a target within 20ft the persons Alignment, Level of Resistance to magic, and surface thoughts (as per Psi-Scan) are revealed. This is a magical informational effect.
By magically reading the “Earth” in a target within 20ft the targets number of physical or magical hits is revealed. This is a magical informational effect.

One glaive owned by the Ishmaic is immune to Shatter, Warp, Melt, and all other weapon destroying effects, even those that would function on supernatural objects. If the Glaive is lost then the character gains no achievement points for the dungeon, but a new one is gained for the next dungeon.
Provides the 1st Weapon mastery in Glaive. If this is already owned then the characters base damage with a glaive is increased by 3 points.

Rather than animating trees the Samila instead awakens bare earth turning it into a Golem. This requires bare un-worked earth/stone/rock to function. Any “Enhance Tree” evocation owned will function on Stone Golems instead.
Additional Innate Earth Shift as 1st to 8th abilities
Additional Innate Meld with Stone as 1st to 8th abilities.
Grants + 1 Innate PAC to the head, and grants Immunity to Sand Storms and similar effects. Must obviously be wearing a full Casyak.
Gains Elemental Resistance (as power master) vs. their own element. May be purchased once per Pasha Status owned.
Has acquired the status of Emir within the Confederacy and should be treated with such respect. This status must be acquired through CC contracts.

Is considered a Pasha within the Confederacy and should be treated with such respect. If an individual is already an Emir then the cost of this ability is reduce by 20 points. This status must be acquired through CC contracts.
Has acquired the status of BayPasha within the Confederacy and should be treated with such respect. This status must be acquired through CC contracts.
Has acquired the status of Bashaw within the Confederacy and should be treated with such respect. This status must be acquired through CC contracts.

Having repeatedly come into contact with Venom from a very early age, no poison can inflict more than 3 TBLP damage upon this character, whatever its previous function was. Poison special effects (e.g. Poison Paralysis) instead cause 3 TBLP damage.

Having repeatedly come into contact with Venom from a very early age, no poison can inflict more than 3 TBLP damage upon this character, whatever its previous function was. Poison special effects (e.g. Poison Paralysis) instead cause 3 TBLP damage.
May use a glaive for distancing even if it is less than 30inches in length.
Now gains + 3 MAC (Total)
Sixth Sense vs. Elementals only.

Distancing the Elementals – When using Distancing to fight Elementals it is increased by 3 points. This applies equally to Enhanced Distancing or Defensive Combat. It is still limited to 12 points, and does not function with Enhanced Weapon Mastery Shield.
True Crafted Armour – One suit of leather or Laminar armour worn gain immunity to Shatter, Warp, Melt, and similar destruction effects.
True Crafted Weapon – One weapon carried (chosen at the start of the day) gains immunity to Shatter, Warp, Melt, and similar as if supernatural.
Resistance to Disarm – Opponents count as having 2 less masteries for the purposes of disarming the individual
Spirit of the Hetyan – Gains + 1 level of resistance to Domination effects for each other Galabhad Clan member on dungeon.
Well Formed Laminar – Gains Immunity to Accuracy vs. Laminar armour worn.
Physical Beguile 1/day – As per the miracle, but requires 60 seconds talking to the target to activate.

Mastery of the Touch – Use of The Touch now only causes the loss of ½ a level. When successfully used it additionally causes 12 points of magical cold based damage to the location touched and the equivalent TBLP (4 hits to monsters).
Mana Rage 1/day – As Cold Rage but only applies to magical damage or damage taken from a magical creature (e.g. Elf, Elemental etc.)
Acts as per Trap Wary but only vs. Magical Effects/Traps. If Trap Wary is already owned this upgrades it to Enhanced Trap Wary.

displayName: Stability in the Flow of Magic
desc: Immunity to magical Bind, Entangle, and Trip/Slip effects.

The Seventh Curse - Resistance to disbeneficial curses. Such curses have the duration reduced to five minutes if the curse was not permanent, or 24 hours if the curse was originally permanent. Curses which reduce armour class are completely ignored. This can act as the immunity to bless/curse pre-requisite for immunity to dying effects.

For each minute spent in preparation and ritual activities, including at least 1 prop for each minute of the rite, the casting damage for the next evocation/spell is reduced by one to a minimum of 0. This cannot be used to assist in the reading or writing of scrolls nor can it be used in the learning of new glyphs

Through the use of a brief ritual of casting stones, tracing lines in blood or the similar, lasting no less than 1 minute, the user can ask three yes or no questions to be answered by the referee. This is a magical informational ability but it does not interfere with the users spiritual powers.
Now gains + 4 MAC (Total)
From Improved Laminar Armour. Laminar armour now grants an additional 2 points of PAC (total)
Gains Accuracy vs. Worn Armour when using HP weapons
Spiritual Linguist – May now read and activate Spiritual scrolls of own alignment up to 3rd level.
Magical Linguist – May now activate magical scrolls and is considered to have 4th level casting for these purposes.
Solid Strength of the Mountain – Gains + 1 Strength for non-combat purposes.
The Third Wind (From the Fourth Wind) – Now Gains ½ damage from all purely magical attacks. Mana users may not benefit from this.
Enhanced Passwall – Passwall is now at will, this costs 6 TBLP per use.
Mastery of Passwall – One use of Passwall now allows the Samila to walk through earth/stone walls (this includes worked stones) for 5 minutes.

Following the Wind Trail 1/day - Through the use of a brief ritual of casting stones, tracing lines in blood or the similar, lasting no less than 1 minute, the user can ask three questions to be answered by the referee using no more than seven words for each answer. This is a magical informational ability.

displayName: Imbue the Winds unto the Glaive
desc: Imbue the Winds unto the Glaive – Allows the character to inflict magical (Grey) damage with any glaive they wield.
Perception – As Ranger ability, but only functions in natural environments, not built up areas.

Gine Bow Mastery – Gine laced bows are of superior quality to their imperial equivalents, and Archers taught to maintain them from a young age. The bow is considered to be a + 1 physical bow, and is immune to destruction effects. If lost somehow the Character gains no achievement points for the dungeon, but gains a new bow for the next adventure.
The Second Wind (From the Third Wind) – Is now deemed to have as many levels of resistances as required to resist any magical level based effect. Mana users may not benefit from this.

The Rending Touch – One use of The Touch also prevents the target from using magical abilities or mana points for 5 minutes. This does not affect on-going spells already active or the animance of an elf/similar. Immunity to non-published dispelling effects grants immunity to this.

Ending the Power 1/day - By touching an ongoing spell, including elementals and elves, and speaking 'I End this power' the spell is dispelled. If the spell has only a mana level then the user suffers 6 TBLP damage for each level of the spell which has been dispelled. In the case of a magical creature harmed or negated by dispels, the user of the ability suffers 30 TBLP of damage and the victim of the ability suffers 30 TBLP (10 hits) of damage. Resistance to dispels applies vs. the damage, immunity to non-published dispelling effects grants complete immunity.

The First Wind (From the Second Wind) – May now choose whether to be affected by a non-level based and non-damaging magical effect. If the effect has a damaging and non-damaging component this can be applied to the non-damaging aspect. If the effect has additional power bases then this may only be applied IF the owner is immune to the other power bases. Mana users may not benefit from this.

The Priest's alignment becomes Neutral from Evil. In addition the previous miracle list is discarded and a new one is created which complies with a neutral alignment as per the rules for Labyrinthian humans. Any innates of miracles bought before this ability was acquired are retained even if they are no longer on the characters miracle list or if the miracle was of evil alignment. If an evil miracle innate is used, then the character cannot use any goodly aligned miracles for the rest of the day, as the spirits of light turn their face from this troubled priest, *however the cost of this ability is multiplied by the highest table from which the Priest can buy abilities E.g. if the Priest can buy from table four, this ability costs 120pts'
Additional racial Beguile innates.
Additional racial Terror Scream innates
The individual is a Baron within the Baronies with the rights it bestows. The status must be acquired via CC contract.
The individual is a Graf within the Baronies with the rights it bestows. The status must be acquired via CC contract.
A Ggrutuck's tough, leathery skin is almost as good as armour. Once this ability is bought the character's skin is counted as innate PAC 2 which however does not stack with any armour worn.
Liar – Now has a Conceal Lie (as racial ability) active at all times.
Gains the first grade of backstab, as Assassin ability.

Some have closer levels of kinship with their powerful ancestors than others; each purchase of this ability grants one more daily use of their ancestor's power as gained at 6th level. It may only be purchased once for every 1000pts or fraction thereof the character possesses.

displayName: Additional uses of Consume Primal Vitae
desc: Additional uses of Consume Primal Vitae
Terror scream ability is no longer level based.
The Ggrutuck are a strong and naturally resilient race. Once purchased a Ggrutuck’s locational life is calculated as half their permanent TBLP (before Items and temporary abilities).
A single Consume Primal Vitae may now be used with a single non-damaging blow, rather than with 30 seconds contact.

Those with enough power may find themselves eventually able to exploit even tenuous and distant links to their ancestors, Purchase of this ability must name a single ancestor of the four which are available as a choice to Barony Humans, and gives the buyer recognised kinship with that ancestor also, granting one use of their ability. The character also becomes capable of buying more innate ability uses as per strengthening the Blood-Ties as above, although they may never have more uses of their secondary ancestor's abilities than their primary ancestor's. This ability may only be bought once, granting a secondary ancestral relationship

Consume Primal Vitae can now cure the user from any amount of disease or poison they are suffering, or it may cure 6/2 per level of resistance of the target. This may not be used in conjunction with Snatched Vitae.
Consume Primal Vitae may now be used to cure 6 TBLP and 6 points of locational damage (spread as desired) per resistance level of the target. This may not be used with Snatch Vitae.
Acts as a Mantic (Bronze and Evil Spirit) Spiritual Mastery effecting 8 levels and below, however it only lasts 5 minutes. Requires 30 seconds talking to the target to trigger.
The lowest of the low. Below even peasants. Members of this Caste will be avoided by most. One of this Caste can never rise above it, no matter how glorious their deeds.

Born to the most common Caste. Heroes often rise from this Caste to glory. Unlike the peasants of the Empire they are sometimes infused with vitae. A person choosing this can either retain their res chance, or gain benefits as per the “Peon” ability.
Born to a family skilled in a craft or trade. While not amongst the wealthiest in the Empire, or the most influential, you are still above the simple Peasant.
The ability to manipulate Magic or Spirits sets you above the masses. While not as respected as powerful warriors, you accorded respect by many.
Charged with serving in the Armies of the Clans and the Empire. You are bound by the Code of Jade and have a duty to protect the people of the Empire.

A member of the Samurai or higher Caste. You are accorded great respect within the Empire. You must purchase the Honoured One Status earlier in the book or if a warrior you may purchase the Samurai Tradition instead.
You have taken an action against the Laws and accords or the Empire. You will be hunted and maybe even killed for your status. You must purchase the Dishonoured One Status earlier in the book.
Loses Utilise Shield Skill and may never recover it. Gains Forearm parry as Monk skill
Can never be dominated to break the Jade Code. If ever breaks the Jade Code then must either commit Seppuku immediately or becomes Dishonoured having to buy the appropriate status.

desc: Do Not Fear While I Stand With You – Acts as per a Discipline innate, but can only be used on someone from Amles of lower social standing that is within 20ft. 1/day

desc: Speak to Ancestral Spirit. As Major Precognition (e.g. it is a neuronic talent and does cost life) usable 1/day

Duty and Honour – If defending a fallen (unconscious, incapacitated or dead) individual of a higher social caste gains +6/2 life and a War Cry, lasts 5 minutes or until the individual recovers. May be used once per day per person.

Allows the user to take the effects of a weapon blows that would kill a member of their own clan. Damage is suffered as per the person being saved. Must be used at the time of death. Cannot stop the Rite of Seppuku.
Allows the user to take an effect that would kill a member of their own clan. Damage is suffered as per the person being saved. Must be used at the time of death. Cannot stop the Rite of Seppuku.
If a user would die from use of Take Killing Blow (above only) then instead falls unconscious for 5 minutes.

Character now counts as tribal and can benefit from a Shaman/Witch Doctor as per tribal rules. May now buy abilities available to tribal characters but looses access to abilities denied to tribal characters.
With 10 seconds looking at an open sky the Alfar can tell the time, to within the nearest ¼ hour.
All Ward Pacts act at 9 levels of potency
Is no longer outlawed by Race, this does not remove any class restrictions, or outlawhoods separately received. This ability additionally costs a Ward Pact.
The Dwarf now calculates their locational life as half their permanent TBLP (Before items and temporary abilities)

Acquisition of this ability precludes the purchase or possession of a multi-race, even a multi-race which is a ‘pure’ or ‘enhanced’ version of basic humanity. The ability is bought in three stages, and must be bought before other abilities are acquired once available. Should the character have several abilities with this requirement, then they may be bought in any order desired. With each acquisition of this ability the character gains +1 level of resistance to stopping effects of a Physical, Magical, Earthpower or Neuronic nature, but not against a Spiritual source. The character also gains one use of the War Cry ability per acquisition of Pure Humanity. Also a character with Pure Humanity gains the benefits of Fated Hero (As table 1 ability)

Restrictions as per Pure Humanity, benefits: With each acquisition of this ability the character gains +1 level of resistance to stopping effects of a power base for which racial innates are gained from 1st to 8th level as well as physical resistance levels. e.g. an Elf would apply this to Magic and Physical, a Farfolk would apply it to Neuronics and Physical. In the case of a race with no racial innate abilities (e.g. an Ogre) the benefit applies solely to Physical stopping effects but grants +2 resistance levels. Additionally all gain a use of the War Cry ability per acquisition of Scion of Primus. Also a character with Scion of Primus gains the benefit of Fated Hero (as per the Table 1 ability).

This must be the first ability bought post 8th. If other abilities have been selected which must also be the first ability bought post 8th, then you may choose which order to purchase them in as long as all are bought before any other abilities are purchased. The character loses all restore to life chance remaining to them, no longer able to hold the vitae of Primus within themselves. May not rebirth or have been rebirthed. The character is so entwined with the fabric of Primus that should they be separated from Primus for more than fourteen days their memories twist and turn such that their new plane of existence appears to have been their home for as long as they can remember. To return to Primus does not cause a return of these lost memories, simply substituting another new set. Effectively the personality dies and is replaced with a new one, not played by the same player. If a peon achieves table 7, they may buy 20% vitae (restore to life chance) for 60 points, once for each table reached from table 7 upwards (i.e. a table 10 peon could have acquired 80% vitae). Such restorations must take place on Primus. It is not envisaged that many characters will take this option, but it is included here for completeness sake. Alternatively the character (as all conventional peons do) can choose to have ‘peon’ added to their race from 1st level, only paying the 10 points if they reach 8th level, at which time it must be the first ability they buy.

The individual has acquired a position of power (through CC contract, previous dungeons, being awarded it or similar) and can produce documents to prove such. If the character loses their position then the ability becomes redundant until the gain a new one. One purchase of this ability covers as many positions of power as owned.
