By shouting this Holy Word the Paladin is instantly cured 60 tblp and 60 points of locational damage by a goodly spiritual source, as per Cure Critical Wounds. Requires at least one post-8th innate of all miracles on the base tree of the relevant sphere. Holy/Unholy Words may be learnt at most 1/3 tables post-8th and the same Word may not be used again by the same shouter within 15 minutes.

This skill allows the warrior to strike a non-damaging blow such that the opponent struck takes one of the following effects: Knockback, Disarm [at normal weapon masteries], or Stunning Blow [affecting 8 levels and below].
This blow may be on any blow of combat after 30secs preparation, or at anytime but costing 6tblp in effort to perform. This skill, although useable at will, can be used at most 1/15 minutes.

This skill allows the warrior to perform a daring deed from the list below.
Salmon Leap, physical Neuro Balance [1minute], Combat Wary [only against the next blow suffered at 12 levels], or Arrow Cutting [1minute] as tables ability.
The use of any of these skills requires either 30seconds preparation, or costs 6tblp in effort to occur.
This skill although, useable at will, can be used at most 1/15 minutes.

By shouting this Holy Word the Paladin negates, destroys or ends one ongoing evil spiritual effect affecting a goodly spirit, such as Spiritual Mastery, a Curse or Suspend Life. Requires at least one post-8th innate of all miracles on the base tree of the relevant sphere. Holy/Unholy Words may be learnt at most 1/3 tables post-8th and the same Word may not be used again by the same shouter within 15 minutes.

By shouting this Holy Word the Paladin destroys all Undead of up to 3rd level within shouting distance or 60 feet, whichever is less. Immunity to Holy Words or Dismissal miracles grants immunity. Requires at least one post-8th innate of all miracles on the base tree of the relevant sphere. Holy/Unholy Words may be learnt at most 1/3 tables post-8th and the same Word may not be used again by the same shouter within 15 minutes.

By shouting this Holy Word all spirits within 20 feet are repelled, take a knockback, knockdown and a 10 second Halt effecting 8 levels and below. Immunities apply separately to each facet; Immunity to Holy/Unholy Word grants full immunity. Does not affect the shouter. Requires at least one post-8th innate of all miracles on the base tree of the relevant sphere. Holy/Unholy Words may be learnt at most 1/3 tables post-8th and the same Word may not be used again by the same shouter within 15 minutes.

By shouting this Holy Word one target with a spirit who hears it cannot approach within 20 feet of the shouter and must move that far away if closer. If the shouter moves faster than a slow walk, fights or casts, the effect ends. Lasts at most 15 minutes. Requires at least one post-8th innate of all miracles on the base tree of the relevant sphere. Holy/Unholy Words may be learnt at most 1/3 tables post-8th and the same Word may not be used again by the same shouter within 15 minutes.

By shouting this Holy Word the shouter gains a Spiritual Know Foe against the target, deducing all spiritual information from them. The target cannot effectively use activated spiritual powers or abilities directly against the shouter. Immunity to Un/Holy Words or Spiritual Informational Effects grants immunity. Lasts at most 15 minutes. Requires at least one post-8th innate of all miracles on the base tree of the relevant sphere. Holy/Unholy Words may be learnt at most 1/3 tables post-8th and the same Word may not be used again by the same shouter within 15 minutes.

By shouting this Unholy Word all those within hearing, up to 60 feet whichever is less, take a standard Undead Touch effect chosen by the shouter: Paralysis, Freeze, Fear, Disease or Level Drain. Does not affect the shouter. Immunity to Unholy Word or the respective effect grants immunity. Requires at least one post-8th innate of all miracles on the base tree of the relevant sphere. Holy/Unholy Words may be learnt at most 1/3 tables post-8th and the same Word may not be used again by the same shouter within 15 minutes.

By shouting this Unholy Word all within hearing, up to 60 feet whichever is less, are affected by a non-level-based Beguile Spirit lasting at most 60 seconds. Does not affect the shouter. Immunity to Beguile or Unholy Words grants full immunity. Requires at least one post-8th innate of all miracles on the base tree of the relevant sphere. Holy/Unholy Words may be learnt at most 1/3 tables post-8th and the same Word may not be used again by the same shouter within 15 minutes.

By shouting this Unholy Word all within hearing, up to 60 feet whichever is less, take a Cause Serious miracle to the head. The shouter is instead cured 24/24 in spiritually evil curing if at least one individual is harmed. Resistances and SAC apply normally; Immunity to Unholy Words grants full immunity. Requires at least one post-8th innate of all miracles on the base tree of the relevant sphere. Holy/Unholy Words may be learnt at most 1/3 tables post-8th and the same Word may not be used again by the same shouter within 15 minutes.
Grants immunity to Discern Smell and Locational Sniff.
Grants +6 tblp stamina for damage from potion kick-outs only.
Now has 12 tblp total for potion kick-outs.
Now has 18 tblp total for potion kick-outs.
After 30 seconds examination of a potion will reveal the kick-out from consuming it.
Will now give full details on a healing potion. For non-standard potions this will only work at the referee’s discretion.
Will now give full details on a poison. For non-standard potions this will only work at the referee’s discretion.
Will now give full details on a general potion. For non-standard potions this will only work at the referee’s discretion.
Increases the character’s Maximum Armour Class by +1.
With a further 30 seconds use of Enhanced Evaluate gains another 7 words of useful information on the object, usable 1/day.
Takes 10 seconds and acts as one question from a Communication I miracle.
Takes 20 seconds and acts as one question from a Communication 2 miracle.
Now takes only 2/3 damage from triggered traps, cumulative with any other similar skills such as Trap-Wary.

Previously a recipe, the scout has a set regime of herbs, liquids and exercise. This grants +6/2 life and +1 level of resistance; however, it costs 500 grulls per time they play. A scout can choose not to pay the grulls and will gain no benefit from the ability. This is a flesh and blood effect. Herbalists and Poisoners may buy this ability at half cost.

Whilst on adventure may make daily temporary potions at no grull cost. This requires excellent phys reps for potion-making equipment and ingredients, and enables the manufacture of potions equal to the character’s normal weekly make per day. These potions take 2 minutes per batch to make. This may be done in addition to normal weekly makes at the desk.
Grants immunity to the Backstab ability.
Allows the user to wear master-crafted plate armour, if previously able to wear master-crafted chainmail armour.
A physical informational effect; this requires 10 seconds study of the target and reveals whether they are outlawed or not.
From Lock-Picking standard skill, may now Pick Locks at will.
Now adds +2 base damage grades to blows struck from behind, with the same conditions as Backstab.
+2 skill levels in one type of potion making (healing, general or poison). Skill level in other potion making types is halved (round up).
With 30 seconds close inspection will reveal if a trap’s effect is physical, magical, spiritual or other, and what the likely effects of triggering it are.
Increases the character’s maximum armour class to +2 from +1 maximum.

If the character has 50% or greater chance of success for making a particular potion, they no longer have to roll for success but automatically succeed on half the batches (round up). Need not use this ability unless desired. On a day on which the character is playing they may use Alchemical Preparation to make up to their weekly limit in potions in addition to normal make allowance.
As per Salmon Leap, but may only be used backwards.
May now perceive spiritual creatures walking in walls, floors or similar; is considered to be able to see a rough outline of them at all times.
May now learn innates up to 3rd level for spells and 2nd level miracles. Those with Recognise Earth Power may now learn Earth Power innates at 12pts/EP up to 2nd level.
Intimidation innates that have failed to Fear the intended target, for example because the target was unaffected, now allow the Bully Boy to enter a 25% cold rage against the target if they desire.

Gains Read Languages skill and, after 30 seconds studying, a Lucky Idea 1/day about any scriptures or written words they can see. If Read Languages is already possessed gains an additional Lucky Idea as above.
The benefits of Local Lad now apply in any urban environment.

On a day when making potions at the desk and actually playing the character on an adventure that day, all failed potion rolls are instead made as one day temporary potions. This ability may not be used with Alchemical Preparation.
An additional use of the basic tendency ability, and at all times gains +1 level of resistance to Domination effects not from own military superior.

If own master is not on the same adventure may choose a single temporary replacement for that adventure. On-adventure abilities are gained as normal, but no off-adventure skills are granted. Once the temporary charge is chosen it may not be changed that day. Should the temporary charge die that day, then the Henchman will receive no achievement points for that day’s adventure.
Gains Danger Sense whilst out in the wilds or rural areas, and only whilst not within 20 feet of any other person.
With 5 minutes time-in work on any singular piece of equipment may protect that object from the next breaking effect, such as Shatter targeted at it. Usable at will.
When applying Holy or Unholy Water to own weapons it will last for 2 blows per dose rather than one.
Gains a second innate Primal Strike. May use both innates on one weapon and inflict Magical and Spiritual damage (Necro) at the same time.
Grants +2 DAC non-stacking with Blesses, Curses, Watchings or similar.
Potion kick-out stamina returns at the rate of 1 tblp per 5 minutes.
Now adds +3 grades of damage to attacks from behind in the same way as basic Backstab.
+1 max damage, max Quin, using Backstab on first blow from behind, with each hand if using Either-Handed weapons. Targets immune to Backstab are not immune to this increase in max damage.
At will may call a Time Freeze to draw an O class Dagger.

Uses innate Dexterity AC offensively rather than defensively. Loses a chosen amount of Dexterity AC, not that granted by potions, items, spells, etc, but one target’s AC is reduced by that many points versus blows from the user. This lasts 5 minutes and cannot be ended prematurely, or ends when the target is slain.

If a creature is entirely helpless, but able to speak, may force them to answer three questions truthfully unless they are completely immune to pain. A goodly character may not use this skill. This skill may be used a maximum of 1/hour per target.
Immunity to physical informational effects does not negate this ability unless the target is also disguised by the Disguise skill. Penetrate Disguise may not be combined with this ability.
When used on self, a disguise worn cannot be penetrated by Penetrate Disguise. Must still be appropriately phys-repped on adventure, or no change.
After 30 seconds observation may determine whether a target is wearing a disguise, and roughly what their appearance is beneath the disguise.

May use one spirit item, which must be personalised to you. If the item is destroyed you may choose another item to use with this ability. This may be any spirit item but may not be personalised to another and must be of the appropriate alignment as per a Priest. Neutral characters must decide if they are aligning to good or evil spirits.
Grants Unarmed Combat as per Warrior skill.

Allows the user to hear the movements of any creature within 60 feet. Effectively, when the character uses the ability by declaring 'Acute Hearing' all creatures within hearing should indicate their broad race category and location. At referee discretion some creatures may not make sounds, and things walking within walls are generally silent as the walls muffle their noises.

Allows the user to smell out the odour of all creatures within 60 feet. Effectively, when the character uses the ability by declaring 'Locational Sniff' all creatures within hearing should indicate their broad race category and location. At referee discretion some creatures may have no odour at all, and things walking within walls generally cannot be smelt. Ethereal creatures will generally have no smell.
Grants the user immunity to Acute Hearing.
Increases the skill level in a single standard skill by another +1, making +3 in total. This ability is not asterisked, and may be taken only in one skill.
May use spirit items of own alignment (Good / Neutral / Evil).

May now read spiritual scrolls of miracles up to half the user’s skill level in Read Glyphs and Languages (round up). These scrolls must be of the appropriate alignment as per a Priest; neutral characters may read neutral spirit scrolls and may choose either good or evil alignment for this ability, but if they later multi-class to Priest they are still bound by that choice.
Now has +2 masteries with dagger.

On-adventure make allowance is now increased to be equal to the skill level in each different branch of potion. Thus a potion maker with 6 skill levels in Make Healing Potion and 3 skill levels in Make Poison could make 6 batches of healing potions and 3 batches of poison.

With one hour’s rest may regain a used innate that is available as a standard or specialist skill, for example Stealth or Salmon Leap. May not be done at the same time as any other meditation. May not be used by Spies to regain neuronic innates. In the case of Flesh Mending, 6 points is regained in an hour.
May choose to start the adventure having pre-made some or all of the batches available via Hero and Mercenary Alchemist.

displayName: Two Isn’t as Good as One
desc: If using a B class weapon then Surprise Blow and Greater Surprise Blows abilities now apply to the first two blows, rather than the first blow with E class weapons.
Begins adventure with 3 doses of adventure-temporary 6pt tblp cure potions.
Begins adventure with 3 doses of adventure-temporary BV 6 potions.
May now use Earth Power items with the same facility as a Druid.
May now use Neuronic items with the same facility as a Neuronic class.

Begins adventure with an adventure-temporary simple bomb. The phys rep should be a tennis ball or object of similar size. Time Freeze should be called the instant the bomb is thrown. When the ball comes to rest all those within a 20 foot radius take 18 tblp damage, 3 to each location, stopped only by innate (non-armour) PAC at a rate of 6/1 for every point of PAC. Once used, Cache is destroyed.

If not carrying any permanently supernatural items other than elven enchanted objects, is immune to supernatural sights such as mana sight, spirit sight, elemental sight and neuro-sight. Ability is broken for 15 minutes if the character attacks or runs.

Grants immunity to all spiritual informational effects. Recognise Spirit still gives a Yes/No answer. Does not grant immunity to spiritual sight but would stop it yielding extra information such as alignment.

Grants immunity to all magical informational effects. Recognise Mana still gives a Yes/No answer. Does not grant immunity to magical sights but would stop it yielding extra information such as mana colour.
Exactly as the Assassin ability on Table 7 above. Only usable when wielding daggers.
The character moves lightly by habit, and is immune to the Tracking ability.
Is now able to use Perception versus any target, whether hidden supernaturally or physically from sight.

May take a Pathfinder standard skill from this book which is not normally available to the class, with a base skill level of 1 if applicable. Individual class restrictions still apply, for example Thugs may never make potions and only Wayfinders may acquire Prayers of Guidance.

May take a Pathfinder specialist skill from this book which is not normally available to the class. Individual class restrictions still apply, for example Thugs may not learn potion making skills and only Wayfinders may acquire Chosen of the Faithful.
Grants +6 points of damage from behind. This does not modify max damage in any way and does not stack with the Warrior ability Veteran Fighter.
Now has +2 masteries in one nominated weapon type.
Grants a non-supernatural Chameleon (self) once per day.
No longer needs to apply base race makeup; however the quantity and quality of the disguise makeup worn should at least match all the makeup and costume restrictions possessed.
When using Backstab gains +X max damage for the first blow with either hand. X equals the number of grades of Backstab owned. This max damage does not apply if a person is immune to Backstab.
May now 1/day move at slow zombie speed without breaking the effect of the Stealth innate. It is still broken should the scout break any other conditions, such as talking or attacking.
Now adds +3 grades of damage to attacks from behind in the same way as basic Backstab.
Grants 6th Extra Level of Life, but is not available if the character has entered into any other bracket bar Warrior.

Functions in all ways as a standard Cache; however, on exploding it inflicts 12/2 non-supernatural flaming damage to all within 20 feet, to which only innate PAC applies to reduce the damage. All objects within the radius suffer the effects of an Ignite spell, catching fire if flammable.

Functions in all ways as a standard Cache; however, on exploding it flashes unbearably brightly, blinding all with their eyes open and able to see it within 20 feet. No damage is inflicted. The blindness lasts 2 minutes, and Immunity to Blindness applies.
First blow of combat cuts through PAC.
Grants the Pathfinder Monk Locational Curing as per the Monk skill.

May alter any sort of Cache so that it does not explode immediately on impact, but instead detonates a fixed amount of time later. Takes 30 seconds of phys-repping fiddling with the Cache, after which it may be set to explode between 2 seconds and 5 minutes after the impact of being thrown.

May cross supernatural lines or wards without triggering their effect. To do this, the user must move at no more than half-speed across the line and must be aware of its presence. If the scout has immunity to informational spiritual effects, may cross spiritual lines; magical informational effects, magical lines, and so on. Still may not cross impenetrable barriers.
Assassin’s Eye will now reveal supernatural hits if the relevant recognise skill is owned. It also becomes an informational effect of that power base.
Judge Strength will now reveal a target’s supernatural levels of resistance if the appropriate recognise skill is owned. It counts as an informational effect of that power base.
Judge Profession now becomes an informational effect of any power base for which a recognise skill is owned, not just physical.

If the user successfully uses Judge Strength, Judge Profession and Assassin’s Eye on a target, gains +3 Backstab, stacking with published grades, on the first blow versus them within the next 30 seconds. If the person is unaffected by any of these discerns then the extra Backstab is not gained. Usable x1/day.

Functions in all ways as a standard Cache. However, on detonation the explosion is much larger, inflicting 36/6 physical damage to all within 20 feet in the same way as a Cache, and causing a Knockback and Knockdown to all within the radius. At referee discretion this may cause structural damage if used within a building or similar.
Should the assassin attack from behind, the first blow of that combat receives +1 damage grade, limited by maximum damage.
Ambush now applies to the first blow of each hand. Can only be in the Scout or Warrior brackets if this ability is owned.

If the target is unconscious or unable to act even if hit, is of flesh-and-blood nature and is susceptible to the type of damage inflicted by the character using this ability, then the target may be slain in a single blow with a 10 second concentration period preceding the blow.
After 5 seconds observation of a target within 9 feet, may discern whether they are Evil in alignment. This is a physical informational effect.

May now inflict maximum damage of Quin from behind. Damage from Surprise Blow is now based on Quin not Quad, so that Six may be called with Backstab. However blows not from behind or on a helpless target are at max of Triple at all times unless the character is also in the Warrior bracket.
Grants +3 DAC solely for the purposes of Force Majeure.
Grants +6 DAC solely for the purposes of Force Majeure.

Is now aware of the movement of all creatures within 20 feet in a way similar to Wanderer’s Hunch; any creature which the player can see in the real world, whether hand in the air or not, may be watched when they are moving. Does not apply to motionless creatures.
Greater Stealth is now an at-will ability, but still only applies to Stealth innates. This does not function with at-will Stealth abilities including 1/15 minutes or similar.
May now cross wardings that are warding barriers under the same conditions as Ghost.

Solitaire is now altered such that items carried of a specific type negate the ability against that power source. For example, a scout carrying a magical item but no spiritual objects could use Solitaire against Spiritual Sight but not magical ones.
Now adds +3 grades of damage to attacks from behind in the same way as basic Backstab.

May now apply Surprise Blow to the second blow of each hand. This functions with Two Isn’t as Good as One, meaning the first two blows with a B class weapon are Greater Surprise and the third and fourth blows Surprise Blows.
While under a Stealth or Greater Stealth gains immunity to magical and elemental sights. Lasts 5 minutes. 1/day.
While under a Stealth or Greater Stealth gains immunity to spiritual sights. Lasts 5 minutes. 1/day.

After successfully using Assassin’s Eye, Judge Strength and Judge Profession on a target they may spend a further 30 seconds studying them and the assassin’s max damage increases from Surprise and Greater Surprise Blows apply even if the target is immune to Backstab. This is a physical informational effect with a range of 20 feet. Can only be in the Scout and Warrior brackets if this ability is owned.
Is now immune to Perception abilities except Wanderer’s Hunch and Sense Motion.
Now applies to any form of own innate Chameleon used, but not from items.
Need not be aware of the wardings transgressed but must still be moving at a maximum of half speed.
Now adds +4 grades of damage to attacks from behind in the same way as basic Backstab.
Ambush now grants +2 grades on the first blow and +1 grade on the second.

preReqs: at least 4 innates of Eye to a Kill
desc: May now be used at will, max once per target per day. May only be within the Scout and Warrior brackets if this ability is owned.

While under a Stealth or Greater Stealth, Solitaire may be applied regardless of items carried provided the scout has immunity to informational effects of the relevant power base. This does not affect other Solitaire restrictions such as attacking or running.

Now gains No Max Damage First Strike of combat from behind. Greater Surprise Blows now applies to the next two blows, and Surprise Blow to the fourth and fifth blows. Requires 60 seconds’ study of the target before it is used. This prep time may not be reduced by any means. May only be in the Scout and Warrior brackets if this ability is owned.
Now adds +5 grades of damage to attacks from behind in the same way as basic Backstab.
Is now immune to Wanderer’s Hunch and Sense Motion but only whilst under the effects of a Stealth, Chameleon or similar and stationary. This ability goes down for 5 minutes if attacks anyone.

displayName: Membership of the Deci Assassin Guild: Enforcer
desc: Status stage one. Gains +3/1 life. Step through the Shadows 1/day: acts as a 20 foot range Shadow Shift. This only functions in urban environments, including buildings and the like.

preReqs: Membership of the Deci Assassin Guild: Enforcer
displayName: Membership of the Deci Assassin Guild: Butcher
desc: Status stage two. Gains +6/2 life total. Can now use Step through the Shadows while using a Stealth without breaking the Stealth.

preReqs: Membership of the Deci Assassin Guild: Butcher
Membership of the Deci Assassin Guild: Enforcer
displayName: Membership of the Deci Assassin Guild: Executioner
desc: Status stage three. Is now Ostracised within the Labyrinthian Empire. Gains a second use of Step through the Shadows as per stage one and may buy extra innates at 60 points each, max 2. 1/day may trigger a Step through the Shadows in response to a blow, declared within 2 seconds of the blow landing; instead of shifting, gains half effect the blow. May buy extra innates of this response at 40 points each, max 2.

displayName: The Halls of Nobility Shield Maidens: Guardian
desc: Status stage one. Membership must be decided at 1st level and this is purchased as the 1st ability post 8th, or can only be obtained via CC contract. May select a chosen individual to protect. The chosen individual gains a stacking 6 points of Live to Minus the first time they need it, doubled if they are a Noble of the Empire. Free and Clear 1/day: when using Trap Wary may take one individual within grabbing distance with them, granting them the benefits of Trap Wary as well.

preReqs: The Halls of Nobility Shield Maidens: Guardian
displayName: The Halls of Nobility Shield Maidens: Protector
desc: Status stage two. Gains a second Free and Clear innate. The Live to Minus 6, or 12, granted to the chosen individual now applies at all times, not just the first time it is needed.

preReqs: The Halls of Nobility Shield Maidens: Protector
The Halls of Nobility Shield Maidens: Guardian
displayName: The Halls of Nobility Shield Maidens: Pretorian
desc: Status stage three. Free and Clear may now be used at will for the chosen protectee. Any innates are retained and can be used on other people.

Any Wizard or Warlock may learn known Standard or basic spells innately so they can be cast without mana cost, but still with normal life-point cost. Chosen spells must already be known and be of own colour(s) or grey; Grey Wizards may choose from each colour already known, and Warlocks may choose offensive spells already known.

Two wizards buy this simultaneously and name each other. The apprentice gains +3 mana of the master's colour; the master gains +1 casting level in that colour only. Both wizards must share the same primary colour.

Gains a 1 mana reduction when casting 1st–4th level Ivory spells, 2 mana reduction for 5th–7th, 3 mana reduction for 8th–11th, and 4 mana reduction for 12 mana or higher spells. This only stacks with Expertise and is lost if the character ceases to be bound by the Ivory code.

+1 level of mana and casting, cumulative with Tables 9 and 12. May not path or multi-class outside the Wizard bracket, and may not buy abilities except those available to Wizard, ALL classes, or those gained as racial abilities.

While one or both hands hold a non-weapon magical focus and neither hand holds a weapon, the caster temporarily gains 2 casting levels until the focus is put down. Usable at will but not during spell research; if the focus is used to strike or parry a blow the points are lost.

While one or both hands hold a non-weapon magical focus and neither hand holds a weapon, the caster temporarily gains 2 casting levels until the focus is put down. Usable at will but not during spell research; if the focus is used to strike or parry a blow the points are lost.
Gains an extra 10 mana (total).
From 1st Rank of Mana: gains an extra 19 mana (total).
1st extra level for calculating damage suffered by the spell caster.
From Casting Level I: 2nd extra level for calculating damage suffered by the spell caster.
From Casting Level II: 3rd extra level for calculating damage suffered by the spell caster.
Gains +5 total non-grey, non-opposite specialist glyph slots.
Reveals to the mana-user how much mana they have remaining.
1st Weapon Mastery with Sword of Power, Sabre of Light & Truth, or Sabre of Darkness & Deceit.
May fill a specialist slot with a Standard glyph of choice. Costs 5pts + 1pt per spell level and spell level squared × 10 in grulls.
costCalculation: 5 points + 1 point per spell level (plus spell level squared x10 grulls)

desc: Now gains 4 specialist slots per Elemental colour instead of 3.
Now gains 1 specialist slot per New colour.

Retains enough from Silver Tongue of Daysaris to speak and understand a slow broken form of that language for the rest of the adventure. Immunity to Informational Spells on the foreign-language speaker prevents the spell functioning.
From Specialists I: gains +10 total non-opposite specialist slots.
Any published weapon-enhancing spell may be altered to include a Glaive among permitted weapon types; the verbal may be adjusted slightly if needed.
From Cultural Style Ishmaic I: now also applies to summoned magical weapons such as Sword of Power.

When casting a spell, may alter the verbal slightly to call on a different patron power or similar, provided the verbal remains close enough to the published version to be clearly identifiable. Does not apply to scrolls, written rituals, or similar.
As per the standard Wizard ability.
Gains the ability to cast the Detect Magic cantrip; each use still costs 1 TBLP.
May read spirit runes and mana glyphs, cast spiritual and magical scrolls of appropriate colours and alignments, including teaching scrolls.
Grants discern associated mana and spirits on self.
Gains the ability to use shields. Metal shields count as one Bastard Sword worth of metal.
Gains +2 total non-grey, non-opposite combat spells into capacity.
May purchase extra glyphs with points at a cost of 10pts + 5pts per mana point.
May buy any published ability that solely increases specialist slots at half cost. May never acquire non-published spells.

May not second colour and may now only cast standard spells. Gains access to all Standard Elemental spells and takes no casting damage from spells costing 1 to 10 mana. Does not grant Expertise in those colours but does allow scroll writing where normal specialist-glyph rules would allow it.
From 2nd Rank of Mana: gains an extra 27 mana total (from 19).
From 3rd Rank of Mana: gains an extra 34 mana total (from 27).
From 4th Rank of Mana: gains an extra 39 mana total (from 34).
From Casting Level III: 4th extra level for calculating damage suffered by the spell caster.
No damage when casting any 1st to 4th level spells.
May cast the Advanced Grimoire glyph Improved Detect Magic. This does not use a specialist slot.
Gains +2 mana for own-colour offensive glyphs and +3/1 life. May not hold a second colour.
Gains +3 mana for own-colour glyphs and +1 casting level for own-colour glyphs. May not hold a second colour.

Gains a second colour. It must suit alignment and may not oppose any racial colour held. If Grey is taken as second colour, the Wizard may lose the 5 base specialist slots to gain 3 of each Elemental colour instead.
Gains a second colour. It must suit alignment and may not oppose any racial colour held. If Grey is taken as second colour, the class follows a similar pattern to Wizards for specialist access.
May buy spells from the Advanced Grimoire at 5pts per mana point for spells of 10 mana or less, or 50pts + 3pts per mana point above 10 for higher spells. May never use teaching scrolls.

Grants neutrality to all Elementals of the user's own colour or colours. Neither side may willingly initiate harm or deliberate detriment to the other; if the spell caster breaks this, the ability is lost permanently.
Must be purchased per colour. The Table 3 ½-effect own-colour-of-magic ability no longer applies to beneficial spells of own colour.
After 10 seconds concentration, own-colour cantrip causes no casting damage. If more than one colour is owned, may be bought separately for each colour.
After 10 seconds concentration, own-colour cantrip causes no casting damage. If more than one colour is owned, may be bought separately for each colour.
Half cost when buying innates of one spell. Buying innates of any other spell costs twice normal cost.
May wear any magical master crafted plate armour.
Reveals all of the user's remaining Magical Innate powers.
May drink up to eight 6pt healing potions per day as per Monk class.
Now gains 'buy as Warrior' from 'buy as Warrior Subclass'.
Gains glyphs of Dispel 11–15. Contrary to normal rules, the Sorcerer does not take ×2 casting damage when learning these spells.

Only purchasable by Wizards who possess a Basic Wizardry colour. Allows the user to summon a 15 Mana Elemental of their own colour. Costs no mana and no casting life to perform, but still requires the verbal. Usable 1/day.
Only purchasable by those who have opposite colours. 1/day may repel all creatures of the opposite element in front of the user and within 10ft, throwing them back 20ft.
From Rainbow: now gains 5 specialist slots per Elemental colour instead of 4. May not learn Specialists II (+10 specialist slots).
May perceive through own eyes, make small movements such as reading or eating, and may choose to end meditation early. Speaking, active movement, or using in-game abilities still breaks meditation.
Magical discern with 20ft range revealing whether a creature is of Demonkind. At-will yes/no answer.
May cast published spells and miracles mantically up to 6th level, from 4th.
May purchase non-Standard glyphs of own colour with points at 10pts per mana point.
With 10 seconds study, Recognise Mana reveals the colour of mana present and its broad type, such as warding, offensive, or defensive.
Additional uses of the standard Self Heal ability. This is still affected by the Total Heal Cap rules as for a 1st Class Priest.

From Elemental Squire: +4 mana for own-colour offensive glyphs, +6/2 life, and +1 MAC against spells of own colour only. May not acquire additional specialist glyph slots beyond those owned at 1st level.

From Elemental Apprentice: +6 mana for own-colour glyphs, +2 casting levels for own-colour glyphs, and +3% researching own-colour glyphs. May not acquire additional specialist glyph slots beyond those owned at 1st level.

From Chromatic Wizard: now gains access to all standard New Colour spells. This does not grant Expertise in those colours but does allow scroll writing where normal specialist-glyph rules would allow it.
Gives the character a 100% chance to make a normal magical scroll.
1/day innate. While within Magical Darkness, any black mana spell cast costs 1 less mana to a minimum of 0. Lasts 5 minutes and ends early if the caster leaves the darkness or it is removed.
1/day innate. When casting Lightning Bolt, may change it into two Stormblasts striking different targets; each target also takes a Knockdown and a Thunder Clap.
1/day innate. For 5 minutes the Wizard’s skill level is deemed infinite. This does not affect casting level.

1/day innate. Within 2 seconds of a blow landing, may call 'Warp' to break the weapon as per the Brown spell and prevent the damage; if Warp does not work, the Wizard instead gains the benefits of a Rockskin against that blow.
1/day innate. While within a Mist spell, any Ebony spell cast costs 1 less mana to a minimum of 1. Lasts 5 minutes and ends early if the Wizard leaves the Mist or it is removed.
1/day innate. May cast any published Gold self-only glyph onto a Marked Ally at touch range.

1/day innate. One weapon that strikes the caster first suffers a rust before causing damage; if not destroyed and it is a sharp physical weapon, the Wizard only suffers 1 point per grade from that blow. Declare 'Water' within 2 seconds of suffering the blow.
1/day innate. Increases the range of one published spell: Touch becomes 1"+, 1"+ becomes 20'+, and 20'+ becomes Line of Sight. If the spell has a radius of effect, that radius is doubled instead.

1/day innate. If Enhance Weapon is cast while under Ivory Warrior, the Enhance Weapon lasts for the duration of Ivory Warrior, up to 30 minutes. Applies only to normal-duration runes of Ivory Warrior.

1/day innate. For 5 minutes the Wizard is covered in flames and may grant any weapon touched a Fireblade for 0 mana after 10 seconds concentration per weapon; the Wizard also causes Ignite (Touch) at all times during the effect.
1/day innate lasting 5 minutes. Any Silver informational spell cast during the duration counts as a magical informational effect rather than a spell.
1/day innate. A Flash spell cast by the Wizard also causes all within the radius of effect, except the user, to become magically blind for 30 seconds.
1/day innate. Allows the Wizard to stack two Empower Form spells on themselves or on one person.

1/day innate. Against one target, Frailty of Age or Nature of the Child may reduce Strength or DAC below 0; if it does, the target becomes weak and unable to run, cast, fight, or similar, as per the 5-minute stage of a disease.

From Aware Meditation: may be active during meditation, but it ends if the wizard casts a spell, moves faster than a slow walk, attacks, or suffers damage. May talk and use passive abilities; may not leave a 30ft radius from where the meditation began. Meditation increases still cap normally.

From Second Colour: the Wizard’s first and second colours are both treated as 1st colour, enabling 1st-colour-only purchases. This causes loss of all standard grey glyphs unless kept in specialist slots only; if one colour is Grey, all specialist slots beyond straight 8th are lost and cannot be regained. The character may not gain any further colour by any means.
Requires an excellent spellbook phys rep. After 1 minute total concentration reading about the spell to be cast, the spell costs 1 less mana to a minimum of 0. Only cumulative with Expertise.
Requires an excellent spellbook phys rep. After 1 minute total concentration reading about the spell to be cast, the spell costs 1 less mana to a minimum of 1. Only cumulative with Expertise.

The wizard may now only cast spells directly relating to combat. All glyphs cast cost 1 less mana, not stacking with other reductions except Expertise, to a minimum of 1 mana. The Wizard may also buy post-8th ALL abilities that typically exclude Wizard, such as Strength or War Cries.
Makes any one O or B class weapon +0 magical while the character uses it.
Makes any one O or B class weapon +0 magical while the character uses it.
Makes any one O or B class weapon +0 magical while the character uses it.
Makes any one O or B class weapon +0 magical while the character uses it.
Yields both the type and the mana level of the elemental.
Mana regained through meditation becomes 2 per 15 minutes or 14 per full hour.
From Facility I: no damage when casting 5th to 7th level spells.
From Facility II: no longer takes damage casting any spell from 1st level up to two levels below the mage’s casting level.
After 10 seconds concentration, gains a 20ft radius yes/no sense for the opposite colour of magic. No locational information is given.
Grants +2 DAC in a Bless-like manner and does not stack with Bless, Chosen, Awareness, Watching, or similar effects.
Base mana is now calculated as Sorcerer.
Base spirits per level increase to 4 from 3.
From Specialists II: gains +15 total non-opposite spells into capacity.
May cast Grey Standard glyphs as per a non-Grey wizard. These still must be acquired through teaching scrolls, but no longer take up specialist slots.
Any rage possessed now additionally applies against magic.
As the warrior ability: gains a 25% reduction in damage suffered after all other calculations.
1/day for 5 minutes the user can see size and colour of mana, elven flux, or wizard rune flux.
1/day for 5 minutes the user can see size and colour of mana, elven flux, or wizard rune flux.
Allows the Wizard to path into the priest bracket.
From Specialists I: gains +10 total non-opposite spells into capacity.
Allows the user to enter a deep meditative state for 15 minutes, at the end of which they gain the benefits of a full hour’s meditation. They cannot regain mana again for three hours afterwards.

For every point of Max A/C above 12 gained from Ivory Warrior, the caster gains 1 point damage reduction versus weapon blows, to a maximum of 6. Only gained for temporary runes of Ivory Warrior and not enhanced versions.
As Sixth Sense but only detects magically moving creatures and does not require DAC 6.

Counts as an additional Tribe Member for calculating the Witchdoctor’s Mana. May buy three plus one per three post-8th tables reached; this cap includes similar abilities that also add tribesmen for mana calculation.
Void no longer requires the target to be in Magical Darkness, though it still does not work on targets in supernatural light or direct sunlight.
Storm Blasts conjured by Storm Caller are no longer limited to one per 10 seconds.
Hammer of Might may now conjure any O or B class weapon of the caster’s choosing.
When cast on a willing target, including self, Vanish Animate costs only 10 mana.
Level lost from casting Chains of Fire now returns in 30 minutes instead of 1 hour.
Heart of Ice now inflicts cold-based magical damage and therefore works on non-flesh-and-blood targets that have a statted chest location, excluding normal Elementals.
Increases complete-hour meditation recovery from 7 mana to Wizard skill level mana per hour.
Allows the Wizard to cast one standard spell of first colour up to 3rd level for 0 mana, at most once per 15 minutes.
Immunity to bruising using MAC.
Immunity to bruising using MAC.
May now cast Prismatic Ward versus all colours of magic.

displayName: Immunity to Bruising using MAC, SAC and DAC
desc: Immunity to bruising using MAC, SAC and DAC versus Pure Mantic blows.
From Lesser Power Mancy: may now cast any available published spell or miracle mantically, up to 6th level.
May choose to inflict magical damage of own colour with Empowered Bo-Sticks rather than generic magical damage.
As the Ranger ability Perception, but applies against magical effects only.
From Casting Level IV: 5th extra level for calculating damage suffered by the spell caster.
6th extra level for calculating damage suffered by the spell caster.
May now cast and benefit from up to 12 runes of Ivory Warrior. If 7 or more runes are cast, the duration becomes 1 hour.

displayName: Immunity to all Magical Informational Effects
desc: From Immunity to Informational Spells: Recognise Mana still gives only a yes/no answer, and mana sight may see but learn nothing further about the target.
As the priestly ability Divine Guidance, allowing the Wizard to use magical powers at full potency regardless of location.
As the Table 1 ability Apprentice Bonding.
May cast a single published spell by simply saying the spell name. Costs mana as normal and also costs one casting level for 1 hour.
Any published mana cost reduction applying when casting a stackable glyph may now apply to each rune of that glyph; any preparation time is also cumulative.
Any published mana cost reduction applying when casting a stackable glyph may now apply to each rune of that glyph; any preparation time is also cumulative.
Increases complete-hour meditation recovery from 7 mana to Wizard skill level mana per hour.
May now calculate mana and skill casting level at one level higher.
May now calculate mana and skill casting level at one level higher.

Grants immunity to Domination and to listed stopping effects of own mana colour, Resistance to Own Element (as per the Power Master specialist skill), immunity to natural occurrences of own element, and half damage from supernatural attacks of that element.
The wizard is permanently counted as walking on or through their own element, as appropriate to Air, Earth, Fire, or Water.
Unaffected by all supernatural darkness, mists, or similar area effects that obscure vision. Does not grant immunity to non-area sight effects such as Bedazzle or Shimmer.

displayName: Immunity to Negation of an Embodied Sylph
desc: Elementals embodied by the wizard are no longer cancelled by contact with other elementals and do not negate them.
Published Thrall spells are cast with an additional free rune. This is cumulative with Expertise.
May cast Fire Dart at will with full verbal for no mana, costing 1 unreducible TBLP once per 10 seconds. Range remains 10ft. Must be able to cast Fire Dart.
May cast Air Dart at will with full verbal for no mana, costing 1 unreducible TBLP once per 10 seconds. Range remains 10ft. Must be able to cast Air Dart.
From Ivory Stalwart: may now cast and benefit from up to 20 runes of Ivory Warrior. If 13 or more runes are cast, duration becomes 2 hours.
Thrown rocks may inflict their physical weapon damage in addition to Missile spell damage; grants H skill in magical rocks only.
May lie to any one magical information power once per day.
All meditating creatures within a Haven spell you cast and susceptible to magic gain +x1 meditation rate.
20ft magical discern yielding a yes/no answer.
If the caster spends 30 seconds before casting Water of Life, the benefit on drinking it is increased by 50%.
Own spells require a Dispel 1 mana higher than normal to remove, unless the Grey wizard is dispelling one of their own spells, which instead takes 1 less mana.

Gains one specialist slot in each Elemental colour (Red, Green, Blue, Brown, White, Black). Each may be filled by an Advanced Grimoire spell of the appropriate colour, including by learning with points at 10pts + 5pts per mana point. These spells may not be of an opposite colour if another colour is held.

Gains one specialist slot in each New Colour (Ebony, Ivory, Bronze, Gold, Silver, Jade, Onyx). Each may be filled by an Advanced Grimoire spell of the appropriate colour, including by learning with points at 10pts + 5pts per mana point. These spells may not be of an opposite colour if another colour is held, and the wizard must have the correct alignment for Jade and Onyx.
May not be forced to break the Ivory code by any external supernatural means.
Grants maximum damage Quin, unenhanceable by any means, with a Sword of Power used in two hands.

A magical informational effect with 20ft range asking yes/no: 'Is that target affected by informational spells?' Because it is magical informational, Immunity to Informational Spells does not ignore it.

displayName: Sabre of Light and Truth Master
desc: Grants maximum damage Quin, unenhanceable by any means, with a Sabre of Light and Truth used in two hands.
While under the 8 mana White spell Invisibility, the Wizard can no longer be perceived by mana sight or elemental sight.

displayName: Call Location Shot with Magic and Super Missiles
desc: Call location shot with magic and super missiles.
Call location shot with snowballs.
From Empower Weapon: the empowered weapon is now coloured to one purchased colour of the wizard. If more than one colour is owned, this may be bought separately for each colour.
From Empower Weapon: any weapon used is now +0 magical.
From More Spirits: base spirits now 5 per level from 4.
From Warlock Specialist Skill Metal Resistance: may wear non-magical armour up to master crafted chain mail and use a non-magical weapon up to Bastard Sword size.

From Elemental Knight: +8 mana for own-colour offensive glyphs, +9/3 life, and the first directly offensive own-colour spell costing 3 mana or below each 15 minutes costs no mana. May not use any glyph, even by item, of another colour.

From Elemental Adept: +12 mana and +3 casting levels for own-colour glyphs. May have no specialist glyphs and takes half damage from casting own-colour glyphs (minimum 1 unless no-damage abilities apply).

displayName: Additional Level of Mana and Casting
desc: Grants an additional level for mana and casting that is not cumulative with other base-level increases such as 9th level mana and casting.

Gains one specialist slot in each Elemental colour to be filled by an Advanced Grimoire spell of the appropriate colour, including by learning with points at 10pts + 5pts per mana point. These spells may not be of an opposite colour if another colour is held.

Gains one specialist slot in each New Colour to be filled by an Advanced Grimoire spell of the appropriate colour, including by learning with points at 10pts + 5pts per mana point. These spells may not be of an opposite colour if another colour is held; the wizard must also have the correct alignment for Jade and Onyx.
Reduces damage taken to upper arms by 50% after armour class is counted. Does not stack with other damage reductions; otherwise as Forearm Parry.
As the Monk skill Forearm Parry, but allows weapon blows to be parried from toes to knee.
Grants maximum damage Quin when fighting Elementals while using a two-handed weapon in two hands.
Grants maximum damage Quin when fighting Elementals while using a two-handed weapon in two hands.
Gains a third colour. It may not oppose any colour already owned, must suit the Wizard’s alignment, and once purchased the Wizard may not leave the Wizard bracket including pathing.
Magical discern with 1" range that reveals how much mana the target has left. Costs 3 TBLP per use.
From Specialists II: gains +15 total non-opposite spells into capacity.
From Specialists III: gains +20 total non-opposite spells into capacity.

May cast Slow without mana reductions and with a reduced duration of 30 seconds; it then affects any single target with resistance lower than the caster’s skill level. Only usable when cast with mana; call 'Fleeting'.

May cast Sleep without mana reductions and with a reduced duration of 30 seconds; it then affects any single target with resistance lower than the caster’s skill level. Only usable when cast with mana; call 'Fleeting'.

May cast Freeze without mana reductions and with a reduced duration of 30 seconds; it then affects any single target with resistance lower than the caster’s skill level. Only usable when cast with mana; call 'Fleeting'.

May cast Catalepsy without mana reductions and with a reduced duration of 30 seconds; it then affects any single target with resistance lower than the caster’s skill level. Only usable when cast with mana; call 'Fleeting'.
From Stage One: the free spell may now be a standard spell of own colour up to 6th level. For stackable runes, only one rune is free. The wizard may not leave the Wizard bracket.

Allows one ranged bolting spell to be focused to a chosen location. The spell still inflicts TBLP as normal, and half that amount is also suffered to the chosen location; MAC reduces damage at 2 TBLP/1 loc per point. Immunity to Call Location Shot negates the location effect.
From Double Meditation Rate: now receives 3 mana per 15 minutes, or 21 per hour.
Allows the mage to strike blows against any creature summoned or created by magic.
While the caster has an active Darkness spell upon themselves, gains Traitor’s Shield and Sixth Sense without the usual DAC requirement.
While the caster has an active Embody Sylph spell, gains all the benefits of Bind Elemental on self.
While the caster has an active Rockskin spell, gains an additional Resistance to Sever and Location to Zero.
While the caster has an active Distortion spell, is also immune to weapon masteries as per the White spell Bedazzle.
While within an active Twilight spell, any use of Dispel costs 1 less mana and 1 less TBLP to cast, both to a minimum of 0.

While the caster has an active Sword of Power, may channel published Red touch-range spells through Sword of Power blows. One spell may be discharged per blow and hangs in the weapon while the Sword of Power remains active, up to 5 minutes. The blow damage and spell effect are not cumulative; choose one.
While holding an active Sabre of Light & Truth, gains an additional +2 MAC versus ranged elemental attacks. This MAC stacks unless another effect says it does not.

Useable once ever. After invoking, the mage may not move more than 20ft from the spot. They will not die, have locations stop working, be stopped, or fall unconscious due to damage until the fight is over; if they take enough damage to die they cannot be cured afterwards. They may continue casting even without mana. Enemies may leave, but thereafter hold the mage in awe and will never attack them again.
Unarmed Combat now delivers magic damage.
From Stage Two: the free spell may now be an Advanced spell of own colour up to 3rd level.
From 6 innates of Focussed Casting: may now use the ability at will. It can only be used with ranged spells.
From Max Quin Versus Elementals: maximum damage Quin versus any creature made or animated by magic, including Elves, Magic Golems, and Faeries, while using a 2-handed weapon in two hands.
From Draconic Champion: the maximum Quin damage may now be done with a single O class weapon if preferred.
From 9th Level Mana & Casting: mana and skill casting level are now calculated at a base of 10th level.

From Elemental Master: gains +24 own-colour mana and +4 own-colour casting levels. May Ward Pact mana users and creatures of own colour; this is non-level-based. Grants immunity to beneficial mana not of own colour.
From 9th Level Mana & Casting: mana and skill casting level are now calculated at a base of 10th level.
May now have as many apprentices as desired under Apprentice Bonding. Must re-buy the ability each time, and the casting levels stack.
Gains a third colour. It may not oppose any colour already owned, must be appropriate to the wizard’s alignment, and may not hold dual colour.
Grants a minimum of 4 spirits total.
As the first extra level of spirits, requiring First Extra Level of Spirits first; grants a minimum of 8 spirits total.
Reveals to the priest the number of associated spirits they have remaining.
Reveals to the priest if there is poison within a target with a spirit.
Allows the priest to remember previously discovered unknown undead types; at minimum reveals all published undead, and other names if previously learned.
Instead of a single major sphere, gain all minor spheres and at most one published major-sphere miracle from each standard sphere, still respecting alignment.
The Witch gains a base of 4 spirits per level but may no longer use the Cudgel and becomes a non-weapon-using priest.
The priest may slightly alter miracle verbals to call upon their deity or patron, so long as the verbal remains obvious and close to the published form.
As Recognise Spirit, but also reveals spirit size and number of spirits present within 1 inch.
Now only loses one quarter of a level when casting the chosen level-loss miracle.
May now acquire 8th-level miracles.
Now gains the normal “free” 8th-level miracle as appropriate to the existing miracle list.
Grants the ability to make Paladinic Healing Balm.
Touch range discern reveals whether a target with a spirit is insane: yes or no.
Increases Discern Insanity range to 20 feet.
Discern Nature of Wounds becomes line-of-sight range.
20-foot spiritual informational effect that reveals whether the target is a member of the same Church as the user; usable at will.
20-foot spiritual informational effect that reveals membership of one chosen Church; bought per Church and usable at will.
No damage is taken when casting 1st to 4th-level miracles.
Maximum armour class is increased by 1, to +1 total; maximum 12.
As the second extra level of spirits, requiring Second Extra Level of Spirits first; grants a minimum of 12 spirits total.

Extra levels of spirits, and spirits gained from similar sources, may instead be assigned at the start of each adventure to miracle innates from the character’s miracle list. Once all three extra levels are bought this allows 12 spirits of chosen miracle innates each adventure.

Changes the character one step along the path pure → armoured → warrior → battle → crusading → spirit warrior, in either direction. Abilities unavailable to the new class can no longer be used and their points are wasted.

May use a staff for parrying only. It may not inflict damage, but Distancing Combat style abilities may be bought for use with it; the staff may also be used to draw wardings such as Protection from Spirits.

displayName: Immunity to ‘Spirits of Miracle’ of Own Alignment
desc: The priest is not detrimentally affected by animate Spirits of Miracle of their own alignment, such as a same-alignment Spirit of Causing; this applies only to animate spirits of miracle, not other versions of those miracles.
Half previous effect from Victim’s Revenge.

With 10 seconds of concentration at touch range may permanently kill an already-dead target so that spiritual Restore Life will not work; mantic restoration still can, but at twice the normal restore-life-chance cost.
Grants neutrality to undead of 5th level and below: they may not attack the priest and the priest may not attack them.
1-inch spiritual informational effect that discerns a Ward of Power, Protection from Spirits, or similar warding line, and reveals whether it is a minor or major ward where appropriate.
Reveals the amount of spiritual innates remaining to the priest.
Grants 1st weapon mastery in one class of pure spirit weapons.
Maximum armour class is increased by 1, to +2 total; maximum 12.
Resistance to Lack of Faith miracle.
1/day may repel all undead in the priest’s front arc up to 20 feet away or until a solid barrier is reached.
Invoke Evil inflicts 72/12 instead of 36/6.

Specialise in one miracle tree. The priest may not have any major-sphere miracles outside that tree (except control undead as noted), and may buy one miracle from the tree at half cost for each points threshold achieved. May not possess Devotion II.

Specialise in one miracle tree. The priest may buy one of each innate on the tree at half cost for each points threshold achieved, but must buy the entire tree once before buying any miracle on it again. May not possess Devotion I.

The priest becomes aware of the death of any member of their priestly guild, the approximate location of the body, and the approximate circumstances of death; this is a spiritual informational effect.

Summons a minor angel of the priest’s faith to aid them for 15 minutes or until slain. It has 12 spiritual hits, an appropriate purely spiritual one-handed weapon, 12 good spirits usable on goodly miracles from the summoner’s guild list (or standard good miracles if independent), 8th-level resistances, active spirit sight, and counts as Angelkind.

Calls a minor angel into the priest for 5 minutes, granting the angel’s 12 good spirits, active spirit sight, purely spiritual form, and similar powers as the summoned angel; while embodied the priest is vulnerable to effects that banish or destroy Angelkind.

Summons a minor abishai of the priest’s faith for 15 minutes or until slain. It has 12 spiritual hits, a purely spiritual bastard sword, fears Good of 3rd level and below, may walk through non-spiritual walls, shadow shift once, has 12 evil spirits for evil miracles from the summoner’s guild list (or standard evil miracles if independent), 8th-level resistances, active spirit sight, and counts as Daemonkind.

Calls an abishai into the priest for 5 minutes, granting the abishai’s 12 evil spirits, fear of Good up to 3rd level, wall-walking, one shadow shift, active spirit sight, and purely spiritual form; while embodied the priest is vulnerable to effects that banish or destroy Daemonkind.
Summons a +1 purely spiritual one-handed weapon of choice for one hour, usable by anyone capable of using neutral spirit items.
Summons a +0 purely spiritual one-handed weapon of choice for one hour; it is +2 versus spirits of the opposite alignment and is usable by anyone capable of using good or evil spirit items.
Allows the priest to identify the miracle name of a spirit of miracle.
20-foot spiritual informational effect that reveals whether the target belongs to a Church, is independent, or similar; exact detail is at referee discretion.
Reveals whether the target is meditating, sleeping, or spiritually inactive.
20-foot spiritual informational effect that reveals whether the target is Demonkind: yes or no.
+1 SAC versus good spirit sources only.
+1 SAC versus evil spirit sources only.
Half level loss when casting Curse of the Unliving.
Upon the Witch’s death an evil spirit rises and may cast permanent Curse at will until removed by a Bless from a Goodly Witch or Hospitaller, or until 15 minutes pass.
Grants a 100% chance of making a normal scroll.

The priest may perceive through their eyes, may choose to end meditation early, and may perform simple non-moving tasks such as eating or reading while meditating, though they may not talk or move around.
1st- to 3rd-level Scriptures of the Faith no longer count towards the scripture cap.
Cure Wound may now be spread across locations as desired by the caster.
May now hang a one-handed Causing miracle on each hand.

Dismissal miracles no longer require a solid object to back the undead against. The priest declares “Spirit of Evil fly from this place!” before the final dismissal phrase, but must still close to within 9 feet to complete the miracle.
Standard-handbook undead summoned by this character remain under control for twice the published duration.
Grants the Read Languages skill.
Reveals the level of effect of an identified spiritual domination effect.
Discern Spiritual Mastery also reveals Beguiles and other spiritual domination effects such as Voice of Power.
Halt and Stasis now have 20-foot range.
Reveals the remaining duration on a Warding-sphere miracle at 1-inch range.
Makes one O- or B-class weapon, while held, +0 spiritual and of the priest’s alignment.

Each master-crafted armoured location gains SAC equal to half the PAC granted by the armour. If at least four locations are covered, that SAC also applies against damaging non-blow effects such as Cause Grievous Wounds or Spirit Bolt.
Any master-crafted armour worn counts as +0 spiritual and applies its full PAC value against purely spiritual weapon blows.
One carried shield counts as +0 spiritual and may block purely spiritual weapon blows and similar effects.
Whenever a creature with a spirit is moving unseen in the priest’s rear arc, the priest is aware of a presence behind them; the player must make use of this by roleplay.
Regains 2 spirits per 15 minutes of meditation.
May actively use spiritual sight rather than passive recognition alone.
Casting miracles from the priest’s major sphere costs 1 fewer spirit, to a minimum of 1, where appropriate.
As Aware Meditation, but may also perform more involved stillness-compatible tasks and remain more alert while doing so.
The priest fully counts as a creature of their alignment for relevant spiritual effects and may follow a stronger ethos of pure good or evil as appropriate.
The Witch’s Dying Curse of Unhealing now requires three different Goodly 8th-level Witches to cast Bless to remove it.
The Friar is reduced to 2 spirits per level and may not cast 7th- or 8th-level miracles, but cannot be excommunicated by the guild master and counts as neutral for damaging spell or miracle effects.

1/day, after preaching for 10 seconds, may stop a single fight as a mass 10th-level Stasis that also affects creatures such as undead. If the Hospitaller has pathed to at least 6th level the effect is also mantic.
No damage is taken when casting 5th- to 7th-level miracles, in addition to 1st- to 4th-level miracles.
The priest cannot be raised as undead unless willing.
Grants +2 DAC that does not stack with Bless/Curse/Watching/Awareness style abilities.

With an excellent religious text containing all miracles on the priest’s base list and their runic verbals, spending 10 seconds per miracle level preparing allows the next immediate casting of that miracle to cost 1 fewer spirit, to a minimum of 1. This is non-cumulative with other reductions or increases of effect.
As Gauge Spirit, but also reveals miracle names present, if any.
Each Fetch Spirit counts as an additional tribe member for the calculation of the Shaman’s spirits only; the total Fetch cap is 3 plus 1 per 3 full post-8th tables.

With 15 minutes of eyes-closed meditation, gains the benefit of a full hour’s meditation. May not regain spirits by normal means for 3 hours after using this, even if the meditation was unsuccessful. Usable 1/day.

Choose one major sphere. Once per hour may cast one unenhanced standard miracle of up to 3rd level from that sphere for no spirits. The miracle must be one the priest could normally cast, and this ability may only be bought once even if the priest has multiple spheres.

1/day destroys one Angelkind by touch, costing the user 10 TBLP per level of the target’s resistance to evil spirits. Damage is suffered only if the target dies; if the damage kills the user they die permanently and may only Rebirth.

1/day destroys one undead by touch, costing the user 10 TBLP per dismiss level of the undead. Damage is suffered only if the target dies; if the damage kills the user they die permanently and may only Rebirth.
If the priest is slain, their slayer is immediately slain spiritually as the priest’s spirit avenges its death.
The priest’s spiritual powers always work normally regardless of location; purely locational penalties to spiritual power no longer apply.

May cure locational damage on self or others up to one third of the priest’s TBLP per day. No more than 2 points per second can be administered, and both giver and recipient must be otherwise inactive during the curing.
Locational curing amount increases to two thirds of the priest’s TBLP.
Locational curing amount increases to the priest’s full TBLP.
Grants immunity to bruising using SAC and immunity to Powercast.
May lie to one spiritual informational miracle or effect.
May negate the effects of a Slayer-style ability while casting a normal Restore Life miracle.

displayName: Immunity to all Informational Spiritual Effects
desc: Now immune to spiritual informational effects such as Discern Nature of Wounds. Recognise Spirit still yields a yes/no answer, and this does not grant immunity to Spiritual Sight.
Grants +6 TBLP of casting stamina solely for the use of Hand of Purification / Putrefaction.

May hold Causing miracles on the hands indefinitely so long as the hands remain open and upward and no other Causing miracles are cast. Causing miracles no longer discharge on the caster by touching their own body unless desired.
While using a spiritual weapon, the priest may treat that weapon as one hand if O class or two hands if B class for the purpose of touching a target with Causing-sphere and tree miracles.

Resistance to undead dying effects: the priest may choose to fall unconscious for 5 minutes instead. If they also possess Resistance to Dying Effects, they become completely immune to undead dying effects.
Dismissal casting is not broken by the caster taking damage, and undead dismissed on their home plane are destroyed permanently instead of merely dismissed.
Undead raised by this character gain the first grade of Strength, increasing both combat damage and carrying capacity.
Undead raised by this character are not released on the character’s death, and all undead raised gain improved speech as described by type.

If a target is altering the result of a Communication-sphere miracle or spiritual informational effect, such as with Conceal Lie or Deception, the referee informs the priest that something is wrong with the answer.

If the priest would suffer a disbeneficial supernatural effect directly triggered by casting a Communication-sphere or tree miracle, they instead take half damage, double resistance, or may ignore the effect and fall unconscious for 5 minutes.
Level-based Warding-sphere or tree miracles cast by the priest have their level of effect increased by one.

All AC-granting miracles cast by the priest on self grant one additional point of AC. Spirit Shield, Shield against the Dark, and Greater Spirit Shield cast by self on self increase to 24 or 48 points protected as appropriate.

Healing tree and sphere miracles of up to 4th level may be prepared with 10 seconds per spirit point of calm prayer with the recipient, increasing effect by one third. This increase does not stack with other increases of effect.
At will may discern what effect a Healing tree or sphere miracle would have on a target. If a healing miracle is discharged on a target and would have no effect, the priest loses no spirits.
Damaging Force-sphere miracles may be shouted at top voice to additionally cause a Repel, throwing affected targets back 10 feet.

Non-damaging Force-sphere miracles also stun the target for 4 seconds as a Halt, even if the target was immune to the miracle, except where the target lacked a spirit or was racially unaffected rather than immune.
The priest is permanently blessed in the manner of a paladin. All non-supernatural carried objects are likewise blessed, have spirits, and are immune to non-spiritual effects that would destroy them.

Whenever the priest suffers a non-damaging effect for which they possess a direct miracle cure, they may instantly have cast that miracle on themself, paying normal life and spirit cost but requiring no verbal.

For 6 TBLP the priest may infuse a spoken command with power so that a target capable of understanding acts as if Spiritually Mastered for that single command at 1 level of effect, lasting up to 5 minutes or until fulfilled.
Immune to all Dominion sphere and tree miracles themselves, though not to duplicated similar effects. This does not affect Dominion miracles self-cast by the priest.
The Table 4 Summon Spirit Weapon or Summon Aligned Spirit Weapon may instead be used in eight blocks of 5 minutes if preferred.
When meditating for spirits, the base amount gained for a full hour becomes 7.
Enhances one active walk-through-walls effect so it also allows travel through the floor. Usable 1/day, lasts at most 5 minutes, and may be bought up to 3 times.
Any master-crafted armour worn counts as +0 spiritual and applies its full PAC against purely spiritual weapon blows.
One carried shield counts as +0 spiritual and may block purely spiritual weapon blows and similar effects.

May transfer damage from a touched target to self at a rate of 2 points to the priest for each 1 point healed. May heal locational, TBLP, or both; permanent damage cannot be transferred. Requires 2 seconds per 6 points healed.
Allows the priest to use Recognise Spirit on any creature or object they can physically see, but does nothing else.

Grants one Resistance to Avenging Spirit and immunity to dying curses and other dying effects. If the priest ever deliberately inflicts damage by any means, this ability is lost and the points are wasted.
Grants an innate Word of Recall 1/day.
Grants an innate Word of Recall 1/day.
Grants the priest the ability to fully utilise Paladinic Healing Balm.
No damage is taken when casting 8th-level miracles, in addition to the benefits of Spiritual Facility 2.
Grants 6 points of Paladinic Lay on Hands curing per purchase; may be purchased up to 6 times.

Only acquirable by priests with Devotion, in which case the spirits may only be used with the devoted sphere, or by priests who have reached Level 6 Devout Priest, in which case they are freely usable.
Any standard Angel or Abishai summoned by the priest automatically gains all standard priestly discerns and may use any published miracle of the appropriate alignment that the summoner possesses.

With the appropriate text and preparation, the spirit reduction from Wisdom in the Scriptures improves for miracles within the priest’s first major sphere to -1 spirit for 1st–4th level, -2 spirits for 5th–7th level, and -3 spirits for 8th level. Miracles outside that major sphere instead cost 1 additional spirit unless offset by the base ability.
Grants a second mastery from first in a single weapon type.
Empower Weapon now applies to a second weapon used.
All Force tree and sphere miracles are now cast at a base of 9th level instead of 8th.
All Dominion tree and sphere miracles are now cast at a base of 9th level instead of 8th.
The miracle granted by Power Mastered may now be cast once every 30 minutes.
Now regains 3 spirits per 15 minutes of meditation.
Base spirits per level increase by one, from 5 to 6 or 4 to 5. If the character is ever excommunicated they die permanently.
Avenging Spirit now also inflicts 36/6 unreducible spiritual damage and a permanent dying Curse even on a target with resistance.

A constant angelic ally within the priest grants 10 additional spirits usable only on goodly miracles. The priest discerns as Angelkind; if struck by an effect that would banish or destroy Angelkind, they fall unconscious for 5 minutes and lose the additional spirits for the rest of the day.

A bound abishai grants 10 additional spirits usable only on evil miracles. The priest discerns as Daemonkind; if struck by an effect that would banish or destroy Daemonkind, they fall unconscious for 5 minutes and lose the additional spirits for the rest of the day.
Powerful bound spirits grant the priest 10 additional spirits usable only on neutral miracles, with no associated banishment penalty.

The priest suffers only half effect from baneful miracles of the opposite alignment. Neutral priests choose at purchase whether this applies to both Good and Evil, or to Neutral miracles, but not both.

When casting Touch of Death, the chance of it becoming Suspend Life becomes 0%. If bought twice, the minimum damage after ordinary resistances is 36 TBLP and 5 per location except as modified by specific spirit-based reductions.
While using a both-handed weapon in two hands, grants maximum damage Quin versus one chosen group: Undead, Angelkind, or Demonkind.
Grants a 1-inch discern associated spirits [other]; costs 3 TBLP per use.

On the witch’s death, all present creatures with a spirit suffer a progressing curse similar to Cause Disease until the witch is restored to life. Immunity to non-handbook curses applies, and special freeze interaction applies if the witch cannot be restore-lifed and has Fortified Spirit.

Only acquirable by non-weapon-using priests with Devotion, in which case the spirits are only for the devoted sphere, or by priests who have reached Level 6 Devout Priest, where they are freely usable.

Only acquirable by non-weapon-using priests with Devotion, in which case the spirits are only for the devoted sphere, or by priests who have reached Level 6 Devout Priest, where they are freely usable.
Grants immunity to non-handbook curses.
Each damage grade called by the character with a weapon becomes a separate blow versus undead, e.g. double becomes 2 blows.
Each damage grade called by the character with a weapon becomes a separate blow versus Angelkind or Demonkind, e.g. double becomes 2 blows.
At referee discretion, informational miracles may provide answers in the form of visions where desired and appropriate.

From Summoned Weapon Division and three summon pure spirit weapons of the same alignment. Loses those three summon-weapon innates and may instead summon at will a single weapon usable only by the summoner; only one may be active, and it fades if it leaves the summoner’s possession.
The miracle granted by Power Mastered may now be cast once every 15 minutes.
When using Power Mastered, the chosen miracle may now be any standard miracle in the relevant sphere up to 5th level.
Gains +1 spirit per level. Stacks with Dedicated Power and Weapons Priest. The character may not leave the priest bracket.

displayName: Immunity to Non-Standard Undead Touch Effects
desc: Grants immunity to all undead touch effects except Freeze, Paralysis, Level Drain, Disease, and Fear.

displayName: Immunity to Non-Standard Undead Touch Effects
desc: Grants immunity to all undead touch effects except Freeze, Paralysis, Level Drain, Disease, and Fear.

Usable once ever. The priest may not move more than 20 feet from the chosen spot, does not die or fall unconscious until the fight is over, and may continue casting miracles even without spirits, but if enough damage is taken to die they cannot afterwards be cured. Enemies who leave permanently hold the priest in awe and will never attack them again, nor pass by them.
Chosen of the Faithful grants +3 DAC total instead of +2.
After purchasing this ability, the priest may acquire the second major-sphere-specific ability from Table 8 for that sphere.
